attributes.context: The sentence is part of the University’s nursing floating and assignment guidelines, which also require that floating assignments be within a nurse’s educational and skill level, give priority to float-pool employees, use volunteers, agency, per diem, and overtime staff, pay specified floating differentials, and review floating quarterly.

extraction_text: To do so, the University will assign an employee during his/her orientation period, e.g. new hire, new program implementation/equipment introduction, in such manner as to enable the employee to acquire the necessary experience and training to assure safe practice when he/she is floated.
